result: pass; six rideable escalators connect concourse and promenade

independentQA.ownership: Independent QA; only /tmp scripts, exact baseline/archive copies, copied-only fixture instrumentation, numerical results and screenshots. No production source edits or commits.

method.functional: Initial placement per scenario, then actual first-person controller updates, real keyboard/touch events, walking approaches/boarding, passive rides, disembarkation, menu actions, and shop/lift interactions. Deterministic25ms stepping in a copied-only test bridge; a real touch joystick boards the Arrivals escalator. No production mutable test API was added.
method.render: Same24 desktop/mobile views at DPR1, with all views prewarmed before measurement. Cameras fixed and controls disabled. Timings are Chromium ANGLE/SwiftShader callback/submission cost, not hardware FPS; the normal walking/interaction/carry loop is excluded. Existing background animation remains, so small submitted-triangle differences can include existing crowd LOD/visibility variation. Native geometry counts identify the exact added geometry.

headroom.method: Actual static architectural triangle raycasts at navigation-accepted belt, underpass and landing points. Center checks ground camera height1.75m plus bob to1.78m, and belt/landing camera height up to2.20m to include sprint descent smoothing lag; four offset probes check the navigation capsule body height1.70m. GPU treads are intended walking surfaces and excluded.

performance.cpuLimit: Frozen-camera drawing/submission test only; excludes active controller/interaction/carry work. No hardware-GPU or physical-phone FPS claim.

adversarialReview.result: pass; reproduced capture and step-visibility findings resolved
adversarialReview.ownership: Independent adversarial review. Temporary scripts/artifacts only; root applied all production fixes.

resolvedFindings.finding: Automatic capture accepted centres outside the full body-supported tread width.
resolvedFindings.before: Capture±0.87m versus body-supported±0.83m; Arrivals ascent stalled at floor0.310865m, descent at the upper lip, with passiveTransport stilltrue.
resolvedFindings.fix: Capture matches width/2 minus0.27m navigation body probe, plus1e-6 floating-point tolerance.
resolvedFindings.verification: All six flights, safe centres0/±0.82/±0.829/±0.83 complete; unsafe±0.86 nevercaptures.

resolvedFindings.finding: An initial narrower±0.82m fix left a 1cm dead fringe where legal riders could stop being carried after strafing to a guard.
resolvedFindings.before: Actual D-key strafe/release at offsets0.82928–0.82998m stayed walkable but stopped conveyor movement.
resolvedFindings.fix: Use the exact navigation body-fit width±0.83m instead of an extra arbitrary margin.
resolvedFindings.verification: Twelve actual strafe/release cases across all flights and two timestep sizes continue1.6m over2seconds.

resolvedFindings.finding: One-sided horizontal nosing planes disappeared above eye height, so most upper risers read as an unbroken dark ramp.
resolvedFindings.fix: Opaque DoubleSide nosing material; same geometry and two shader draws.
resolvedFindings.verification: Before/after bottom approach captures show all upper step edges; both programs compile with no console/page errors.

resolvedFindings.finding: Static flat plate top0.015m exceeded moving tread top0.012m; flattened tread bodies were hidden and nosings had near-coplanar clearance.
resolvedFindings.fix: Lower plate top to−0.04m, retaining moving treads and comb plates above it.
resolvedFindings.verification: Final close-ups show moving tread surfaces at boarding and clear safety edges.

adversarialReview.sourceQualification: Final native boundary/strafe checks use the exact final source hash. scopeLimits: Chromium ANGLE/SwiftShader verification; no hardware GPU or physical-phone frame-rate measurement.
Camera art poses freeze the app in copied-only QA mode; HUD floor labels in those images are not UI-state assertions.
Handrails are plain continuous rubber profiles; adding decorative moving marks was unnecessary for convincing motion.

resourceReview.method: Native geometry/shader-position simulation, resource events, immutable buffer versions and navigation samples; no WebGL browser used.

limitations: Frozen-view software WebGL drawing/submission timings exclude the normal controller loop and do not establish hardware GPU or physical-phone frame rates.
The floor sampler smooths visual stair risers for comfortable first-person movement.
The original ramps and four-level lifts remain available.
No direct Vercel deployment command was run by this pass.
